collector.name: MBO Discovery Collector
notes: No POST, PUT, or DELETE API calls are used.
Record attachment binary contents are NOT downloaded.
Uploaded JavaScript/CSS customization source files are read with GET when possible.
Record data is limited to records visible to the currently signed-in user.
File keys inside exported record/settings data are removed from the final export.

properties.label: Management By Objectives for Staff & Chief
1.Adaptability (1)
options: ไม่สนใจข่าวสารสถานการณ์ปัจจุบัน
รู้และสามารถแลกเปลี่ยนความคิดเห็นได้
ยอมรับการเปลี่ยนแปลงและสามารถปรับตัวเข้ากับสถานการณ์ได้
ยอมรับการเปลี่ยนแปลงและปรับตัวพร้อมทั้งคิดวิธีการทำงานใหม่ๆ ที่เหมาะสมตามสถานการณ์ที่เปลี่ยนแปลงได้

properties.label: 2.Problem Solving (1)
options: ไม่สนใจปัญหา ปล่อยจนหัวหน้างานพบเอง

properties.label: 3.Customer Focus (1)
options: ปฏิเสธและไม่ใส่ใจคำร้องขอของลูกค้าทั้งภายในและภายนอกซึ่งการตอบสนองความต้องการลูกค้า ต้องอยู่พื้นฐานความเข้าใจที่ตกลงไว้
รับฟังความต้องการและช่วยเหลือในบางเรื่อง
ตอบสนองได้ตรงตามความต้องการของลูกค้าอย่างสม่ำเสมอ
รู้แนวโน้มความต้องการของลูกค้าและเสนอตนเองที่จะให้ความช่วยเหลือในด้านต่างๆ ก่อนที่ลูกค้าจะร้องขอ
สามารถกำหนดมาตรฐานการบริการลูกค้า ให้สามารถใช้งานได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ

properties.label: 4.Additional Value Creation  (1)
options: ยึดติดกับแนวคิดและวิธีการทำงานเดิมๆ
ประยุกต์ใช้ความคิดเห็นของผู้อื่นเพื่อปรับปรุงขั้นตอนการทำงานของตนเองได้
คิดวิธีการใหม่ๆ ในการปรับปรุงกระบวนการทำงานของตนเองให้ดีขึ้น
เป็นผู้คิดริเริ่มและสร้างกระบวนการทำงานของทีมให้ดีขึ้น
ให้คำแนะนำและกระตุ้นให้ผู้อื่นคิดที่จะปรับปรุงอยู่เสมอ

他者との意見交換を含め、世界情勢を把握している。変化に対応するために迅速に適応している。他者を助け、助言ができる。

    ];

    // 1) ซ่อนทุกฟิลด์
    allFields.forEach(fieldCode => {
      kintone.app.record.setFieldShown(fieldCode, false);
    });

    // 2) แสดงเฉพาะฟิลด์ที่ระบุ (เช็คป้องกันกรณี visibleFields เป็น undefined)
    const fieldsToShow = visibleFields || [];
    fieldsToShow.forEach(fieldCode => {
      kintone.app.record.setFieldShown(fieldCode, true);
    });
  }

  /**
   * ปิดการแก้ไข (disabled/read-only) ของฟิลด์ตาม disabledFields
   */
  function disableFields(event, disabledFields, visibleFields) {
    const user = kintone.getLoginUser().code;
    if (user === 'admin-form') {
      // admin-form: ไม่ตั้ง disabled ใดๆ
      return event;
    }
    const record = event.record;
    const dFields = disabledFields || [];
    const vFields = visibleFields || [];

      // แก้ไข: ตรวจสอบว่า fc มีอยู่ใน vFields และ record มี field นั้นจริงก่อนเรียกใช้ includes
      if (vFields.includes(fc) && record[fc]) {
        record[fc].disabled = true;
      }
    });
    return event;
  }

  /**
   * ตรวจสอบค่า Status → ซ่อน/แสดง + ปิดแก้ไข fields ตาม mapping
   */
  function handleStatusVisibility(event) {
    const record = event.record;
    const rawStatus = record.Status ? record.Status.value : '';
    const status = rawStatus.trim();

    console.log('[DEBUG] Current Status:', JSON.stringify(status));
    console.log('[DEBUG] Available mappings keys:', Object.keys(processFieldMapping));

    const mapping = processFieldMapping[status];
    if (!mapping) {
      console.warn(`[WARN] No mapping found for status "${status}"`);
      toggleFields([]);   
      return event;
    }

    console.log(`[DEBUG] Using mapping → ${mapping.name}`);
    console.log('  → show fields:', mapping.show);
    console.table(mapping.show);
    console.log('  → disable fields:', mapping.disable);
    console.table(mapping.disable);

    toggleFields(mapping.show);
    // แก้ไขจุดที่ผิด: ส่ง mapping.show เข้าไปเป็นอาร์กิวเมนต์ที่ 3 ด้วย
    return disableFields(event, mapping.disable, mapping.show);
  }

  function loadCustomCSS() {
    const css = `
      input[disabled],
      textarea[disabled],
      select[disabled],
      input[readonly],
      textarea[readonly],
      select[readonly] {
        background-color: #e5e8e8 !important;

  // ============================================
  // 8) ฟังก์ชัน Validate “Total Weight[A] (%) ต้องเท่ากับ 100”
  // ============================================
  function validateTotalWeight(event) {
    const record = event.record;
    if (!record.total_weight_a) {
      return event;
    }
    const raw = record.total_weight_a.value;
    const num = Number(raw);
    if (
      raw === '' ||
      raw === null ||
      raw === undefined ||
      isNaN(num) ||
      !Number.isInteger(num) ||
      num !== 100
    ) {
      record.total_weight_a.error = 'ผลรวมต้องได้ 100% (The total must be 100%)';
    } else {
      record.total_weight_a.error = '';
    }
    return event;
  }

  ['weight_a_obj1','weight_a_obj2','weight_a_obj3','weight_a_obj4'].forEach(fc => {
    kintone.events.on(`app.record.create.change.${fc}`, validateTotalWeight);
    kintone.events.on(`app.record.edit.change.${fc}`, validateTotalWeight);
  });

  kintone.events.on(['app.record.create.submit','app.record.edit.submit'], function(event) {
    const record = event.record;
    if (record.total_weight_a) {
      const raw = record.total_weight_a.value;
      const num = Number(raw);
      if (
        raw === '' ||
        raw === null ||
        raw === undefined ||
        isNaN(num) ||
        !Number.isInteger(num) ||
        num !== 100
      ) {
        record.total_weight_a.error = 'ผลรวมต้องได้ 100% (The total must be 100%)';
        event.error = 'ผลรวมของ Total Weight[A] ต้องเท่ากับ 100% (Total of Total_weight_A must be 100%)';
      }
    }
    return event;
  });

})();

RESULT : 1 VIOLATION (ON 26 FEB 2025)	
CUSTOMER : SEI THAI ELECTRIC CONDUCTOR CO.,LTD.	
Cause analysis :	
Problem : Requesting new credit limit amount 2.0 MB while AR balance remained 2.6 MB, which caused credit violation.	
	
why1 : Misunderstanding that new credit limit amount will be effective after current expiry period.	
	
why2 : Lacking of knowledge about credit application preparation and credit process flow after new request approval.	
	
why3 : An error occurred checking the AR balance in the SAP B1 system before requesting credit.
	
Countermeasure:	
Countermeasure 1: The AR balance in the West system must be checked before requesting new credit limit or expiry period extension.
	
Countermeasure 2 : There should be training provided on the credit request process. 
	
Countermeasure 3 : Check the outstanding balance in the SAP B1 system And ask the accounting department about the 
amount that will be refunded within the month that the credit is requested.

(PLEASE SEE ATTACHED SHEET 3)

Result :  Improve TMT&STM PO ratio for running business (Apr'25-Mar'26)

Total amount  :  PO ratio 12.25 % (QT 204 items / PO 25 items)

Mitsubishi    45 /10 (22%)    101/10   (10%)

Total             67/12 (18%)    137/13  (9.4%)            

Remark :  Please see more information in attached sheet.

 - Since the customer reported receiving poor-quality products from another supplier who offered a lower price, we must choose suppliers that meet our standards. As a result, we cannot compete on price with other suppliers.

- We have already changed suppliers when requesting quotations, but they could not offer prices as competitive as the original supplier. In addition, the product quality from some suppliers is unreliable. Therefore, we continue to request quotations from the original supplier.

- The supplier(s) we requested quotations from informed us that they have received many quotation requests but did not receive  PO, which has caused the quotation to be delayed.

Text_area_actual_result_obj1.value:
Based on this year’s performance, total profit achieved is in the range of THB 5.98–7.00 million, which is closely aligned with the planned target of THB 7 million. This demonstrates the ability to generate sales profit at a level nearly reaching the set objective, reflecting strong and consistent business performance.

Throughout the year, I maintained a strong commitment to work quality and customer satisfaction, while effectively managing TASA projects. This has contributed to improved operational capability, supported sales growth, and delivered tangible business results in line with expectations.

Text_area_actual_result_obj4.value:
For the final fiscal year 2025, operations have continued in alignment with the established plans and objectives, ensuring consistency and stability in overall performance.

Within the Trials team, regular coordination has been maintained through weekly meetings, primarily scheduled on Friday evenings. These sessions serve as a structured platform for team members to provide updates on their assigned responsibilities, report on current progress, and highlight any challenges encountered. When issues arise, or potential risks are identified, the team collaborates to propose preventive measures and practical solutions. This proactive approach not only mitigates potential problems but also contributes to continuous improvement in work processes and overall efficiency.

In addition, information management has been consistently maintained through regular updates in the KINTONE system, ensuring that all relevant data is accurate, current, and accessible. Weekly internal coordination, including Thursday updates and Friday trial meetings, plays a critical role in strengthening communication within the team. These practices enhance operational efficiency by aligning tasks with stakeholder requirements and minimizing errors in key processes.

Furthermore, regular meetings between the team and customers have been effectively maintained and closely monitored. These meetings focus on sharing updates, aligning plans, and addressing any operational issues, such as delays in supplier confirmations or communication gaps. Emphasis is placed on maintaining continuous and transparent communication to ensure that all parties receive the most up-to-date and accurate information. This approach supports better decision-making, strengthens collaboration, and ensures smooth project execution.

At present, the TTMET Trials Team continues to maintain regular weekly meetings with customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and alignment across all projects. The meeting schedule is as follows:

Weekly meetings are held every Tuesday with TMA customers (specifically for Project 02DD), as well as with TTC, to review project progress and address any ongoing issues.
Meetings with TASA customers are conducted every Wednesday evening, focusing on updates, coordination, and resolution of any operational concerns.
Every Thursday, the team meets with TTMSB to discuss current activities and progress. These sessions are followed by additional coordination meetings with the TMA PE team to ensure alignment on technical and project-related matters.
In addition, regular meetings are also held with the TTMET Export Team to support coordination on export-related activities and ensure smooth operational execution.

These recurring meetings play a critical role in strengthening communication, improving coordination, and ensuring that all stakeholders remain informed with the most accurate and up-to-date information.

Regarding an issue encountered in my assigned responsibilities under Project 581D (end user: TABJ), a delay occurred due to insufficient communication, which led to a misunderstanding of the work requirements. As a result, the customer experienced a delay in receiving the product. This situation was further impacted by uncontrollable external factors, such as limited vessel availability during the period, as it coincided with the New Year holiday season.

Upon identifying the issue, I promptly informed the team of the problem and its root causes in order to seek guidance and support. The team provided strong cooperation and valuable recommendations to address the situation effectively. I subsequently prepared a formal report (as attached), outlining the cause of the issue, its impact, and the corrective actions taken.

In handling this assignment, I took immediate action to resolve the issue as quickly as possible, ensuring that the product was ultimately delivered to the customer successfully. This experience has reinforced the importance of clear and proactive communication, as well as early risk identification, to prevent similar issues in the future.

Text_area_action_plan_obj3.value:
1. Analyze the Current Delivery Process (Aug'26)
Review the existing process and identify inefficiencies. Attaching files and sending emails individually to customers is time-consuming and involves repetitive tasks.
2. Design an AI-Driven Improvement Approach (Sep'26)
Utilize AI to analyze and design more efficient methods for sending balance confirmation letters, including opportunities to streamline processes through Outlook.
3. Develop and Test the Email Delivery Process (Oct'26)
Apply AI recommendations to develop and test an enhanced email delivery method with attachment handling suitable for operational use.
4. Evaluate Operational Efficiency (์Nov'26)
Conduct pilot testing with actual data, compare processing time with the previous method, and verify delivery accuracy.
5. Implement the Improved Process (Dec'26)
Prepare user guidelines and implement the improved process in daily operations to reduce processing time and enhance efficiency.

Text_area_action_plan_obj2.value:
1. Study Current Issues and Processes (Aug'26)
Analyze the current bank reconciliation process and identify challenges. Manual matching and verification in Excel are time-consuming and prone to errors.
2. Use AI to Design Excel Formulas (Sep'26)
Utilize AI to create and optimize Excel formulas for transaction matching, validation, and identification of unmatched items.
3. Develop a Bank Reconciliation Excel Template (Oct'26)
Incorporate AI-generated formulas into a reusable Excel template to streamline the reconciliation process and reduce manual effort.
4. Test and Evaluate Effectiveness (Nov'26 - Dec'26)
Test the template with actual data and compare processing time and accuracy against the existing method.
5. Summarize Results and Implement (๋Jan'27)
Develop usage guidelines and integrate the tool into daily operations to improve efficiency and accuracy in bank reconciliation.

Text_area_action_plan_obj4.value:
1. Assess Training Needs and Define Training Topics (Aug'26)
Identify essential topics required for daily operations, such as AR Report review, outstanding receivable monitoring, SAP WEST layout configuration, and related report utilization.
2. Prepare Training Materials (Oct'26)
Develop user manuals, operating procedures, and sample datasets to support the training program.
3. Conduct Knowledge Transfer Sessions (Dec'26)
Deliver training and demonstrate SAP WEST functionality, explain AR Report usage, and address participants’ questions.
4. Evaluate Learning Effectiveness (Jan'27)
Conduct hands-on practice sessions and assess participants’ understanding and ability to use the system effectively.
5. Follow Up and Provide Post-Training Support (Jan'27)
Monitor practical application of the training, provide additional guidance as needed, and ensure employees can perform tasks accurately and efficiently.

Text_area_action_plan_obj1.value:
1. Study and Analyze the Current Process (Aug'26)
Review and assess the existing accounting entry process, focusing on activities that require repetitive data entry in the system. Record processing time and the number of manual steps involved to establish a baseline for measuring improvement after implementation.
2. Design and develop a VBA Tool (Sep'26 - Oct'26)
Coordinate with the IT department to ensure compliance with the organization's security requirements. Design an Excel template and develop a VBA tool to streamline accounting entry processes, reduce manual work, and improve user efficiency.
3. Test and Enhance the System (Nov'26)
Validate system accuracy by comparing the results with the existing manual process. Test various error scenarios and exceptional cases, and refine the system to ensure accuracy, reliability, and stability before deployment.
4. Implement and Monitor Performance (Dec'26)
Deploy the solution in the production environment, prepare a user guide, and provide knowledge transfer to the team. Monitor performance by comparing processing time and error rates before and after implementation to evaluate improvement.
